description: This file defines a CKEditor dialog for the 'scayt' (Spell Check As You Type) plugin, including UI elements for options, language selection, dictionaries, and about information.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.ui.dialog.scaytItemList
classes.description: Custom UI element class for managing list of words in the dictionary within the dialog.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.ui.dialog.scaytItemList.prototype.addChild
methods.description: Adds a new word item to the list.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.ui.dialog.scaytItemList.prototype.removeChild
methods.description: Removes a specified word item from the list.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.ui.dialog.scaytItemList.prototype.inChildren
methods.description: Checks if a word is in the list.
